text.content: For 4–5 players using the five new concepts (@UUID[JournalEntry.zQMt8VMfKPoL6INq]{Celeste Arden} to @UUID[JournalEntry.gRfqeOIXEHOcLemr]{Dr. Ruth Abernathy}); with four, one goes unused. David Smith (@UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David Smith}) and Bear (@UUID[JournalEntry.sP1Adp7t6FvaF4zw]{Tom “Bear” Whitman}) are NPC allies of the coterie. These are concepts with backstory; the players build the mechanical character sheet with the core rulebook. Sections marked “Secret” are for the Storyteller only.

pages.name: Which Clans I Recommend and Why

text.content:
The coterie has no Brujah: the city already has four, all NPCs (David, who travels with the coterie, Rosa, Krell, and O'Connor), so it's best not to repeat the clan. Each clan below opens a different front of the plot, so everyone gets their moment.

Clan Plot front Why it works
Ventrue Politics and infiltration of Halloway's circle Puts the coterie inside the antagonist's house. Creates the strongest loyalty dilemma in the adventure.
Nosferatu Information, the underground, and the surveillance network Seattle is the city of data, and a hacker Nosferatu is the natural counterweight to Gale Sentinel and FIRSTLIGHT.
Toreador The Prince's court and Helen's circle With a Toreador Prince, this character lives at the center of the coup. They can also be tied to the podcast.
Gangrel The Sheriff's pack, tracking, and combat Connects to Montgomery and to David's past. Gives weight to the scene where the Sheriff hesitates (@UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}).
Tremere (alternative) Forensics, Blood Sorcery, and the crack in the Masquerade With five players, joins the table. With four, can replace any of the above.

Recommendation for 4 players: Ventrue, Nosferatu, Toreador, and Gangrel. The Tremere stays as the spare. For 5: all five.

Every character appears in the Ward File. When the drive is stolen, they're all exposed at once, and Sheriff Montgomery wastes no time telling them: “You're all on the same drive. You get it back together or you go down together.” It's a Commando coterie, with its domain on the Harbor Island docks, around the hangar David lends them as a haven, and each player gets their folder (@UUID[JournalEntry.vtenvgNlXVPd99Rc]{“Your Folder in the File”}).

The full coterie page (concept, alternatives, members and agendas, customs, type, domain, and shared Backgrounds, with what doc 02 says and what doc 08 settles) is at @UUID[JournalEntry.azX1hjbc0PUp2AA2.JournalEntryPage.kiaygGF4KgylB6fb]{The Archived}.

• David and Bear are NPCs. They help: +1 die to the PC who rolls, or an action you narrate without a roll. They don't resolve on their own what belongs to the coterie, and they don't make its decisions; they give opinions, push, react. David's plot (Vance, Emily, Helen, the Larchmont, Krell) is for the PCs to uncover, and they're the ones who decide what to tell him.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE}: Helen calls SAFE; David summons the coterie. Nadia, if she's in play, arrives on her own: she knows the apartment.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.xWx5IoPih8fX83b1]{A1-E03 · The Sheriff Asks}: this is the coterie's formation scene. Montgomery gathers them all at his farm and assigns David to go with them; David lends them the hangar.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son}: Krell goes after the most exposed Touchstone of any character (Helen, Bear, Maja, Theo, Ingrid…).
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.hAX2tLfjRPJ2o4Tr]{A3-E03 · Face to Face with Krell}: Krell demands David. The coterie decides whether to bring him and how. The PCs earn the steps toward Krell's turn with what they tell him; David confirms, breaks, or gets angry.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}: if Hal is in play, the scene turns against him: Montgomery demands his reports in front of everyone.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.snrsN5RkdAklRIDn]{A4-E01 · Primogen Council}: if Celeste is in play, Halloway offers her up as a traitor. If Nadia is in play, Whitmore uses her as his voice before the Council.
  • Scaling the tests: Difficulties are the ones in the outline; scale the enemies by adding one minor NPC for each player beyond two.
